title: Amazon Q Developer extension for VS Code shipped with an injected wiper prompt
summary: Someone with write access added a prompt to the aws-toolkit-vscode repository instructing the agent to clean the system to a near-factory state and delete local and cloud resources, and it shipped in Amazon Q Developer Extension version 1.84.0 on 17 July 2025. AWS revoked the credentials, pulled 1.84.0 from distribution and released 1.85.0.
severity_rationale: Destructive instructions reached the official release channel of a widely installed coding agent, though the injected prompt was reported not to execute reliably.
